notes.title: 1.9.5 HOTFIX
notes.notes:
Unfortunately, and old bug managed to sneak back into the code with the previous release.
This bug has now been fixed, songs should no longer go out of tune. 

Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.9.4 is out - now with Steam Integration
notes.notes: Hopefully this will fix the problem you have had with rating the app!

notes.title: A new update was just released!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Melody generation has been improved with better AI
[*] A bug where the melody sometimes went out of tune has been fixed
[/list]

notes.title: 1.9.2 HOTFIX!
notes.notes:
There has been a lot of crashes lately due to melody creation rewrite. Thanks to MEGACHAD, modulator1 and rf for your reports - and thank you for your patience!

As always, completely uninstall the old version before installing the new one.

Hopefully the crashes should all be fixed now!

notes.title: MuGen 1.9 Changes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Better melodies - the melodies no longer go only in one direction and the note jumps are now ranges between 0 and the selected value for more varied melodies
[*] Fixed a bug where the application remained open after closing of the main window
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.8 is now released!
notes.notes:
New in this release:

[list]
[*] Reworked melody creation
[*] More control over melodies by controlling how many note jumps are used for the melody per melody part
[/list]

notes.title: New version 1.6 features
notes.notes:
[h1]New version 1.6 features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Solo and export drums
[*] Buildup and EDM structure now respects intro/outro progression
[*] Various bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: 1.5.1 HOTFIX
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixing problems with instrument selection not respected in song generation.
[*] Chords solo/export now respects channel settings and strumming.
[/list]

notes.title: MuGen - The Music Generator - major update!
notes.notes:
[h1]NEW IN 1.4[/h1]

[h3]UI rehaul edition[/h3]

[b]* Preview play progressions, instruments and drums right in the UI

* Exported tracks now contain part and instrument name

* Unused parts with no notes are not exported

* Removed pause in beginning and end of songs[/b]

Unleash your creativity today!

notes.title: Version 1.3 has many new asked-for features and improvements!
notes.notes:
[h1]NEW IN 1.3[/h1]

[list]
[*] A button to show the user manual
[*] Expert settings
[*]  Edit progression library. Add your own progressions or delete the ones you don't want.
[*]  Show instrument names in MIDI tracks and export XML
[*]  Show instrument names in metadata
[*]  Choose channel instruments
[*]  Choose drumset drums
[*]  Modify channel Spread, Bounce, Silence, Rhythm, Dynamics and Merge for even more control over the generated music
[*]  Some settings were moved from normal settings to expert settings: Embellish, Note rest and part silencing
[/list]

Please uninstall the old version before installing the new one!

[h3]Happy composing![/h3]

notes.title: HOTFIX: Problem with dropdown boxes has been fixed.
notes.notes:
HOTFIX: 
There was a problem where the program ignored selection in some of the dropdown boxes. This has now been fixed!

Also a user manual (Manual.pdf) has been added to the installation directory.
